[5:46PM] #Ikorodu #TrafficUpdate 

There is a busy traffic situation from Benson inward Ikorodu roundabout, primarily due to a high volume of U-turns and pedestrian crossings. However, traffic heading towards Aleje remains smooth. Movement inward Sabo Roundabout is busy.

From Sabo Roundabout inward Ile-Epo Oba, traffic is generally encouraging despite some interruptions caused by pedestrian crossings. Further ahead, the road towards High School is free-flowing, although there is slight congestion when approaching the LASTMA yard. 

Traffic along Sawmill, Okegbegun, First Gate, Flower, Jendol, and Redeem remains fast-moving. However, there is a noticeable buildup from ENYO filling station to Odonguyan, attributed to bus stop activities and frequent pedestrian movement.

There is slow-moving traffic from Ikorodu Roundabout inward Ojubode, but the route from Oba Ayangburen’s Palace to Ojogbe is completely free. On the return journey, traffic from Ojubode towards Ladega is slow, mainly because of market activity and tricycles operating in the area. The route inward Onishigida is clear and good to go.

Itunpate and Itunmeko are both experiencing fast movement, although Ota-Ona is somewhat busy due to road alternations. Nonetheless, the route from Ota-Ona connecting to Itamaga is moving smoothly.
Our men are present at important locations ensuring ease of movement.

#FollowLASTMA

[6:00PM] #AlausaIkeja #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic along Obafemi Awolowo Way, from Barracks through Coca-Cola Junction, Radio, Allen Junction to Balogun, is generally smooth. However, there is some congestion approaching Olowu, heading towards Ikeja Underbridge, due to a high volume of turning vehicles at Olowu Junction and spillover traffic from the Ikeja Along overpass. The return journey remains good overall but is slightly busy around Allen and Radio junctions.

Aromire Road towards Adeniyi Jones, including the stretch from Akora Villa to Hacco, is still flowing well. The return journey is equally fair, with mild congestion approaching Allen Junction.

Both inward and outward directions of Lateef Jakande Roa, from Coca-Cola Junction through Cadbury to Omole Roundabout, are experiencing free flow of traffic.

Mobolaji Johnson Avenue, from the Old Tollgate through 7Up Gate, Billingsway to the Secretariat intersection, remains smooth. The connecting stretch of Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo Road towards Otedola Underbridge, along with Governors Road and Governors Avenue, is also moving steadily.

No traffic impediments have been observed at this time. Officers are on ground, effectively managing traffic flow.
